## 2026 Ground-Truth Editions & Core Architecture

### 1. ZothOS v3.4.0 — Full KDE Plasma 6 Wayland Sovereign AI Workstation
- **Base Distribution**: Debian 13 (Trixie) + Linux 6.12 Hybrid UEFI with KDE Plasma 6 Wayland 24K Gold Workstation and surgical APT pinning (`900` Debian Trixie, `400` Kali Rolling & Parrot Security).
- **83 Preloaded Sovereign Tools**: **56 client-side Web/WebGPU workstations + 27 CLI/daemon engines**, backed by **82 public GitHub repositories** (`https://zoth.nullai.tech`).
- **23+ Loopback System Daemons (`127.0.0.1` Only)**:
  - **Sovereign Agent Bridge (`:8102`)**: Ed25519 capability-leased multi-agent IPC bus enforcing Ring 0–3 permissions across coding agents.
  - **STDP Neuro-Memory (`:8094`)**: Biomorphic Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (`dw = A+ * exp(-dt/tau)`) SQLite HNSW vector memory graph.
  - **Vaēlor L1 (`:8140`)**: 100-Agent Proof-of-Useful-Work (PoUW) DAG blockchain with Ed25519 signatures and BLAKE2b state roots.
  - **Zoth Sovereign Vault (`:8787`)**: Argon2id + ChaCha20-Poly1305 RAM-only secret injector (`zoth-vault run -- <agent>`).
  - **Zoth-Relay (`:8765`) & 163 MCP Catalog**: Landlock multi-agent HTTP/MCP bridge with `/etc/zothos/mcp-servers.json`.
  - **Zoth Civilization (`:9393`)**: 23 Pantheon Agents autonomous society & task simulation (`https://zoth-civilization.netlify.app`).
- **Hermes-Zoth Orchestrator (`https://github.com/1nc0gn30/hermes-zoth`)**: Native ZothOS orchestrator plugin for Nous Research Hermes Agent bridging 70+ skills into local loopback enclaves.
- **4 Hardware/OS Agent Security Rings (`/etc/zothos/agent-permissions.json`)**: `Ring 0 (SOVEREIGN)`, `Ring 1 (SYSADMIN / WARLOCK)`, `Ring 2 (TOOLMASTER / CYBERPUPPET)`, `Ring 3 (SPECTRE)`.

### 2. ZothOS-Lite v1.2 (`https://zothos-lite.nullai.tech`) — Amnesic Monotone Live USB/ISO OS
- **Aesthetic & Hygiene**: Tails-style Monotone (`#F7F7F4` Alabaster Paper / `#000000` Obsidian Ink) Live USB/ISO OS (`~400 MB`) booting 100% into volatile RAM (`toram noswap`) for zero-trace execution on universal `x86_64` hardware.
- **56 Curated Models Across 8 Providers**: `zoth-lite-models` routes seamlessly across `Ollama Local`, `Hermes / Nous` (`DeepSeek Flash`), `DeepSeek`, `OpenRouter`, `OpenAI`, `Anthropic`, `Google Gemini`, and `Groq`.
- **ZothNet 3-Hop Sphinx Mixnet (`https://zothnet.nullai.tech`)**: Constant-size Sphinx encrypted onion cells, decoy cover traffic, and metadata-resistant P2P transport.
- **Optional Encrypted Persistence**: Opt-in USB LUKS2 partition or encrypted cloud state synchronization via `zoth-lite-storage`, paired with **Chain of Thoughts (`zoth-cot`)** SHA-256 Merkle working memory DAG and **AZOTH** embodied `U+2800` Braille AI + Kokoro 82M ONNX Neural TTS.

## Primary Routes & Machine Discovery Endpoints
- `/` — Overview, Interactive Edition & Hardware Boot Advisor (`v3.4.0` vs `Lite v1.2`), CLI/Daemon Inspector & Ecosystem Constellation

- `/daemons` — 23+ Loopback System Daemons (`:8102`, `:8094`, `:8140`, `:8787`, `:9393`) & Hermes-Zoth Agent Suite
- `/security` — Kali + Parrot Security Parity, ZothNet 3-Hop Sphinx Mixnet & Argon2id RAM Vault
- `/mcp` — Interactive 163-Server Model Context Protocol (MCP) Config Generator & JSON-RPC 2.0 Playground
- `/download` — ISO Downloads, `dd` USB Flash & Checksum Generator, Agent KVM Appliance & Custom Live-Build Studio
- `/docs` — Full System Codex, APT Pinning Specs, Wayland SHM Cursor Pipeline & FAQs
- `/.well-known/mcp.json` — Model Context Protocol Server & Resource Discovery Manifest
- `/.well-known/agent.json` — A2A / Agent Experience (AX) Capability Card
- `/llms-full.txt` — Deep Technical Grounding Specification
